chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Musa ibn Umar, from a man, from Al-Husayn ibn Ulwan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
A companion of twenty years is a relative.
ai.seo_question: What duration of companionship establishes kinship in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes that enduring companionship for twenty years creates a legal and spiritual bond of kinship (*qarabah*), effectively elevating a friend to the status of a relative. This principle underscores the Shia emphasis on the transformative power of long-term social bonds, granting companions rights akin to family members and reinforcing the importance of loyalty and continuity in interpersonal relationships.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Musa Bin Umar, from A man, from Al Husayn Bin Ulwan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘A companion of twenty years is a relative’.
